name: What information should I gather before meeting with a real estate agent for my luxury home search?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before meeting with a real estate agent for my luxury home search?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a real estate agent for your luxury home search, you should gather information about your financial readiness, including pre-approval status. Also, define your preferences such as desired neighborhoods (e.g., Fisher Island, Las Olas), minimum square footage, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, key amenities (e.g., waterfront access, private gym), and your preferred timeline. This preparation allows Kelby Contreras to efficiently narrow down suitable options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before meeting an agent, gather financial readiness information and define your property preferences, including desired neighborhoods and key amenities.
